brief: Galois theory of q-difference equations (van der Put–Reversat, Ann. Fac. Sci. Toulouse XVI:3, 2007, 665–718) — Galois-theoretic framework for q-difference equations.
extended:
**Galois theory of q-difference equations** — Marius van der Put and Marc Reversat. Annales de la Faculté des Sciences de Toulouse, Tome XVI, no 3 (2007), 665–718.

A Galois-theoretic treatment of q-difference equations: the difference-Galois group, its Tannakian formulation, and the classification of q-difference modules.

**Why it may bear here.** q-difference equations are the ambient formalism for the Habiro-ring and q-holonomic material this corpus works in, and `library/equations-aux-q-differences/` (Di Vizio–Ramis–Sauloy–Zhang) is the companion survey already held. This is the Galois-theoretic side of that pair. A prior for attention, not a claim that a result here is used.
